summary: The checksum-verified typed policy in docs/color-reference.md now owns every light and dark application semantic color. Emission preserves selected palette coordinates in brand-* roles, applies declared WCAG contrast floors to runtime roles, and runtime-theme.css contains only semantic aliases plus provenance-scoped team and flag identity exceptions.
decisions: The typed runtime policy embedded in docs/color-reference.md is the sole authority for complete light and dark semantic role coordinates and contrast requirements.

Selected project palette coordinates remain byte-exact under generated --ds-color-brand-* roles; semantic runtime roles may move toward the declared ink role only as far as needed to meet the WCAG floor.
The emitter records the runtime policy schema and checksum and emits complete :root and html[data-theme=dark] semantic role sets.

runtime-theme.css may define product morphology aliases only through generated semantic roles. Raw HEX is limited to --identity-team-* and --identity-flag-* with explicit provenance, redundant text cues, and a ban on status meaning.
Generated projects/world-cup-hub/design-system/tokens.css was deliberately left untouched for the Ontology Compiler stage.
